description: Retry a failed paid job for free. Transaction and token checks each have one manual retry per job ID; if it still fails, keep the job ID and contact rugshield@fastsoftware.uk for review. There is no automatic refund.

job_id.description: Job ID of a failed paid transaction or token check. Retry that job for free after get_job_result reports failure.
job_id.title: Job Id

name: retry_failed_job

outputSchema.description: Free retry admission or a tool error. Only failed token_risk and tx_guard jobs have one manual retry; risk_panel jobs are ineligible and require support review. A failed status alone does not prove retry eligibility. Read agent_guidance.payment and analysis. A missing receipt or result does not prove no charge or refund.

agent_guidance.description: Optional additive agent instructions; does not replace x402 headers or the original result.

payment_allowed.description: Advisory only; server preflight enforces input validity.

request_example.description: Recommended NEXT action. A blueprint is not executable until its required original context or actual inputs are supplied. No signing or payment is performed by returning this object.

charged.description: Legacy: true confirms settlement, false reports no settled charge for this attempt, null means unconfirmed. Never infer a refund or no charge from null.

code.description: Error code when the tool cannot fulfill this request.

delivery_state.description: Legacy ledger state when returned by a job/retry observation.

eta_s.description: Estimated queue delay, not a completion deadline.

job_id.description: Opaque server-returned job identifier; preserve it exactly.

kind.description: Stored job kind when exposed; production paid checks use token_risk, tx_guard or risk_panel.

payment_receipt.description: Decoded receipt when available after settlement; historical encoded receipts may remain only in receipt_header.

payment_status.description: Legacy ledger or error field. Use agent_guidance.payment for the explicit charge outcome.

receipt_header.description: Stored receipt when available. This is not a new payment proof to authorize or replay.

result.description: Conditional result. Paid results are released only after confirmed settlement; token/transaction jobs expose the saved paid response envelope, while prepaid panels expose their analysis object when ready. Legacy non-purchase jobs may expose their result directly. Absence never proves no charge.

retry_after_s.description: Free polling delay, not a deadline or instruction to authorize payment.

status.description: Analysis and payment are separate facts. ready/done can mean work finished while its paid result is still withheld; needs_review can concern payment or analysis. Read agent_guidance.payment and analysis.

status_tool.description: Free tool to observe the existing retry; normally get_job_result.

status_url.description: Free GET path for this existing job; no settlement or analysis restart.
